question: Which of the following do not live in the canopy of the Amazon rain forests?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Crocodiles**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The question asks which animal does not live in the canopy of the Amazon rain forests.
 
• The canopy refers to the uppermost layer of the forest, where the tallest trees and most diverse plant and animal life reside.
 
• Now, refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 4 of paragraph 2: Plants such as **vines, fungi such as mushrooms, and insects such as butterflies live in the rain forest canopy**. So do hundreds of species of tropical birds and mammals such as **monkeys.**
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above highlighted part, it can be concluded that "crocodiles" do not live in the canopy of the Amazon rain forests.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
